assets/cv/template.tex.reason: Dead and actively misleading. Nothing in scripts/ loads it (verified by grep at migration time: zero references to template.tex, assets/cv or assets/letter in any renderer); render_cv.py assembles its LaTeX inline, and this file had drifted from what is actually generated. A template nobody loads is a second, wrong source of truth.
